articles.title: Revolut wants to take Dogecoin mainstream with its new physical payment card
articles.snippet: The European fintech giant is launching a physical debit card that lets users spend the popular meme coin anywhere Visa and Mastercard are accepted with zero extra exchange fees.

articles.title: Ex-OpenAI's Leopold Aschenbrenner bets big on crypto miners for his $13.6 billion AI play
articles.snippet: Aschenbrenner is shorting Nvidia and AMD in favor of bitcoin miners that own the electricity and data centers needed to fuel the next phase of the AI boom.

articles.title: CoinDesk 20 performance update: Bitcoin Cash (BCH) drops 13% as all assets decline
articles.snippet: Bittensor (TAO), down 9.6% over the weekend, joined Bitcoin Cash (BCH) as an underperformer.

articles.title: UK’s financial payments network is ready for tokenization, regulators say
articles.snippet: The U.K.’s financial watchdog and central bank unveiled their roadmap for tokenization, the use of stablecoins for institutional settlement and a phased transition toward 24/7 operation.

articles.title: Bitcoin Depot, North America's largest bitcoin ATM operator, files for bankruptcy
articles.snippet: Bitcoin Depot, the largest bitcoin ATM operator in North America and publicly listed on Nasdaq, has filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy.
